definitions.gloss: occasionally, from time to time, now and then
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something happens at irregular intervals, not frequently but not rarely either. Slightly more literary than ときどき.

examples.english: It rains from time to time.

examples.japanese: {時折|ときおり}⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: I occasionally recall things from the past.
Outside the window, a strong wind was shaking the trees from time to time.

notes:
{時折|ときおり} is a slightly literary synonym of ⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧. It is preferred in written Japanese and formal narration.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {時折|ときおり} + verb: occasionally ~
- {時折|ときおり}⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧〜: ~ that one shows from time to time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧: sometimes (most common, casual and neutral)
- {時折|ときおり}: occasionally (slightly literary)
- ⟦たまに→たまに：01276_tamani⟧: once in a while (casual, lower frequency)
- ⟦{折|おり}に{触|ふ}れて→折に触れて：19487_orinifurete⟧: on occasion (formal)

USAGE: {時折|ときおり} suggests a somewhat irregular, unpredictable pattern. It often appears in descriptive writing, conveying an atmospheric quality.
